ValidationRule.description: CRM - 4187 Validation for Service Fee when Payment is finalised
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.Prevent_editing_QAC_Service_Fee_for_Paid__c = FALSE, RecordType.DeveloperName = "QIC_Service_request" , ISCHANGED(Service_Fee_Applies__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL (Service_Fee_Applies__c, "Yes - Apply")), Billing_Status__c == "Paid" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Service Fee Applies cannot be changed if the Service Payment is Paid
